meta.description: Speech bubble lines for el Gato, the Chaos Cat Familiar. The watcher sends an event name + placeholders; CCF owns this catalog, rolls a tier, picks a line, fills placeholders.
meta.rarity_visibility: Legendary lines should also trigger the existing 1-in-7 special bubble style, so rarity is visible.
meta.lolcat_dose: Roughly one in three common lines per event is lolspeak; the rest stay dry so the lolcat stays a punchline at ~20 bubbles/day.

placeholders.{count}: number of waiting items, or thousands of cached tokens

meta.idle_split_rule: agent_idle, agent_question and task_done share the same signal (session goes idle after a turn). Disambiguate on the last reply: ends in a question -> agent_question; reports completion -> task_done; otherwise -> agent_idle.
meta.house_rules: Night lines are night-owl-friendly: never tell him to stop or go to bed. Moon is fine.
meta.greeting: No catalog greeting: the companion writes the day's greeting bubble itself at /day-start or session start (free text through the same endpoint), so it fits the actual hour and day.
meta.notes: If a tier is empty for an event, fall back to the next lower tier. 'lore' lines can replace any bubble at legendary weight. 'night' lines can replace a common line during the night window.

night_window._doc: CCF knob: local time; a window may wrap midnight. replace_chance: how often a common line becomes a night line inside it.
